Enter the time as HH:MM, e.g. 22:00.

The values are added up. With a GX device (Cerbo) choose Other manufacturers → Victron Energy GX.

A widget must not overlap another one.

strings.Široka fotografija, omjer 6 : 1 – npr. 3: Wide photo, ratio 6 : 1 – e.g. 3840 × 640 px (for 4K) or at least 1920 × 320 px. The left third is covered by the greeting and logo and the forecast is on the right, so keep the main subject (the building) in the centre. A wider or taller image is cropped around the centre automatically.
strings.Baza korisnika je iz starije razvojne ve: The user database is from an older development version (3.x) and 4.0 does not modify it. Move it out of the data folder and restart the server (a new one will be created).
strings.Aktivacijski kod je točan – postavite sv: The activation code is correct – set your own password.
strings.Račun je privremeno zaključan zbog previ: The account is temporarily locked because of too many failed attempts.
strings.Korisnik je dodan. Aktivacijski kod (vri: The user has been added. Activation code (valid for 72 hours, shown only now): {code}
strings.Novi aktivacijski kod (vrijedi 72 sata,: New activation code (valid for 72 hours, shown only now): {code}. The old password and all sign-ins are no longer valid.
The user has been signed out of all devices.
strings.Poslužitelj preusmjerava na drugu adresu: The server redirects to another address – check the server address (redirects are not followed).

strings.Novi pristupni ključ je izrađen – stari: A new access key has been created – the old one is no longer valid.
strings.Poslužitelj nije verzije 4.0 – instalira: The server is not version 4.0 – install Solar server 4.0.

strings.Kod za uparivanje ne odgovara certifikat: The pairing code does not match the server certificate – check the code and address (the connection may be intercepted).

strings.prijavili ste se jednokratnim aktivacijs: you signed in with a one-time activation code. Enter your own new password – at least 10 characters and at least three character types (lower and upper case letters, digits, other characters) or at least 16 characters.
